sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Sam Houston State University and Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso are both public institutions but differ significantly in size and focus. Sam Houston State University, located in Huntsville, has an undergraduate enrollment of 17,743 students, whereas Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso in El Paso has a much smaller undergraduate population of 242. Additionally, Sam Houston State University charges an in-state tuition of $9,228, while Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso does not provide in-state tuition data. These differences highlight the contrast between the larger, more traditional university setting of Sam Houston State and the specialized health sciences focus of Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance between Sam Houston State University and Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso (SHSU vs TTU), Sam Houston State University provides clear tuition figures, charging $9,228 for in-state students and $19,068 for out-of-state students. Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso does not report specific tuition costs for either in-state or out-of-state students. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Sam Houston State University is $21,983, which is notably higher than the $12,500 median debt reported for Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso. These financial metrics reflect differences in institutional focus and student financial outcomes between SHSU vs TTU.
